name: LivaNova PLC
summary: LivaNova PLC, a medical technology company, designs, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells products, therapies, and services. The company operates in two segments, Cardiopulmonary and Neuromodulation. The Cardiopulmonary segment provides cardiopulmonary products, including heart-lung machines, oxygenators, autotransfusion systems, perfusion tubing systems, cannula, and other related accessories, as well as services related products.
